name: Blockchain AI
desc: AI and machine-learning projects built on Blockchain.

resources.name: Blockchain
resources.desc: "A blockchain is a growing list of records, called blocks, which are linked using cryptography."

resources.name: Artificial Intelligence
resources.desc: "In the field of computer science, artificial intelligence (AI), sometimes called machine intelligence, is intelligence demonstrated by machines, in contrast to the natural intelligence displayed by humans and other animals."

resources.name: Machine Learning
resources.desc: "Machine learning (ML) is the scientific study of algorithms and statistical models that computer systems use to effectively perform a specific task without using explicit instructions, relying on patterns and inference instead."

resources.name: SingularityNET
resources.desc: SingularityNET is a distributed AI platform on the Ethereum blockchain, with each blockchain node backing up an AI algorithm.

resources.name: Intuition Fabric
resources.desc: The goal of Intuition Fabric is to democratize access to AI through a network of deep learning models that are stored on the interplanetary file system and accessed through the Ethereum blockchain.

resources.name: OpenMined
resources.desc: OpenMined is a community focused on building open-source technology for the decentralized ownership of data and intelligence. With OpenMined, AI can be trained on data that it never has access to.

resources.name: Raven Protocol
resources.desc: Raven Protocol is a decentralized and distributed deep-learning training protocol.

resources.name: Thought Network
resources.desc: Thought's blockchain-enabled Fabric fundamentally changes applications by embedding artificial intelligence into every bit of data making it agile, actionable and inherently secure.

resources.name: MATRIX AI
resources.desc: The Matrix AI Network is a public chain that combines AI technology with blockchain technology to solve the major challenges currently stifling the development and adoption of blockchain technology. Matrix is poised to revolutionize and democratize the field of Artificial Intelligence using a blockchain-powered decentralized computing platform.

resources.name: Cortex Labs
resources.desc: Cortex Labs is a decentralized AI platform with a virtual machine that allows you to execute AI programs on-chain.

resources.name: Fetch.ai
resources.desc: Fetch.ai is a decentralized machine learning platform based on a distributed ledger, that enables secure sharing, connection and transactions based on any data globally.

resources.name: Oraichain
resources.desc: Oraichain is the world's first intelligent and secure solution for emerging Web3, scalable Dapps, and decentralized AI.

resources.name: Bittensor
resources.desc: Bittensor is an open-source protocol that powers a decentralized, blockchain-based machine learning network. Related resources.

resources.name: Alethea AI
resources.desc: A research and development studio building at the intersection of Generative AI and Blockchain.

resources.name: Vanna Labs
resources.desc: An Ethereum L2 rollup that supports native, seamless, and trustless AI/ML inferences on-chain to empower decentralized applications.

resources.name: Danku
resources.desc: A blockchain-based protocol for evaluating and purchasing ML models on a public blockchain such as Ethereum. Blog post.

resources.name: Decentralized & Collaborative AI on Blockchain
resources.desc: 0xDeCA10B is a framework to host and train publicly available machine learning models in smart contracts with incentive mechanisms to encourage good quality training data while keeping the models free to use for prediction. Blog post.

resources.name: Ocean Protocol
resources.desc: Ocean Protocol is a decentralized data exchange protocol that lets people share and monetize data while guaranteeing control, auditability, transparency and compliance to all actors involved. Its network handles storing of the metadata (i.e. who owns what), links to the data itself, and more.

resources.name: TrueBit
resources.desc: TrueBit gives Ethereum smart contracts a computational boost.

resources.name: DeepBrain Chain
resources.desc: A decentralized AI computing platform that supplies processing power to companies looking to develop A.I. technologies.

resources.name: Nunet
resources.desc: A globally decentralized computing framework that combines latent computing power of independently owned compute devices across the globe into a dynamic marketplace of compute resources.

resources.name: Phala Network
resources.desc: A decentralized off-chain compute infrastructure for Web3 development.

resources.name: Numerai
resources.desc: Numerai is a hedge fund powered by a network of anonymous data scientists that build machine learning models to operate on encrypted data and stake cryptocurrency to express confidence in their models.

resources.name: Cindicator
resources.desc: Cindicator is a crowd-sourced prediction engine for financial and crypto indicators.

resources.name: Erasure
resources.desc: Erasure is a decentralized protocol and data marketplace for financial predictions.

resources.name: doc.ai
resources.desc: doc.ai aims to decentralize precision medicine on the blockchain by using AI.

resources.name: BurstIQ
resources.desc: Healthcare data marketplace with granular ownership and granular consent of data. By using on-chain storage on a custom blockchain, BurstIQ can comply with HIPAA, GDPR, and other regulations.

resources.name: Hashgraph Online (HOL)
resources.desc: Universal agentic registry built on Hedera Hashgraph. Provides blockchain-based identity for AI agents using ERC-8004 standard and HCS-14 Universal Agent IDs (UAIDs). Enables agent discovery, verification, and autonomous commerce via x402 protocol.

resources.name: AgentFund
resources.desc: A decentralized crowdfunding infrastructure for autonomous AI agents on Base blockchain, enabling milestone-based escrow funding for AI projects and collaborations.
